exposure: Surfactant treatment in the delivery room
nasal continuous positive airway pressure use before intubation as a part of initial resuscitation
patent ductus arteriosus requiring medical treatment
outcome: Patent ductus arteriosus requiring medical treatment
cohort: Preterm infants (≤29 weeks and birth weight <1500 g) registered in the Vermont Oxford Network system
finding: While survival rate increased significantly in the later period, survival without morbidity did not differ, and there were significant differences in several exposures and outcomes between the two periods.
mod_finding: The frequency of cesarean section increased in the later time period studied (P = .025).
